recipes.name: Easy Cucumber Party Sandwiches
ingredients_raw: 1 (8 ounce) package whipped cream cheese with chives
1 (1 ounce) package ranch dressing mix (such as Hidden Valley Ranch®)
1 (1 pound) loaf thinly sliced white bread
0.25 cup snipped fresh dill leaves, or as needed

steps.text: Mix cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, ranch dressing mix, and dried dill in a bowl until creamy and smooth.
Cut crusts from bread slices; cut sliced bread into decorative shapes (such as rounds or flowers) with cookie cutters.
Spread each bread with cream cheese mixture and top with a cucumber slice. Top each canapé with a few fresh dill leaves.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Cucumber Party Sandwiches
raw_recipe.description: Mix a tasty cream cheese spread with dill and ranch dressing and spread on shaped pieces of white bread. Top with a cucumber slice and a few dill leaves for a quick and fresh cucumber party appetizer or snack.

review.reviewBody: Made these for my cousin's 80th birthday party. Very easy to make and delicious. Got lots of requests for the recipe. Did add a dash of worcestershire and made the spread about 12 hours before making the sandwiches so flavors could blend. Will definitely make again.

This is so delicious! I used whipped cream cheese, added 1/2 or less cup of mayo, about the same amount of sour cream and added the powder buttermilk ranch a little at a time to satisfy my taste. I also finely chopped about a teaspoon of fresh dill and stirred that in. I refrigerated it overnight. I used white and wheat bread to make my cucumber sandwiches, cut out in penguin shape. I may not have followed the recipe exactly but I'm thankful that it was available for me to be inspired to try something I thought was only for the tea ladies ??

I used pumpernickle bread & removed the crust from each slice. I then cut each slice in 4 and made 2 sandwiches with spread and a slice of cucumber. I will slice them a little thicker next time or other wise serve them open faced. Family loved them and they were gone in no time!

These were a huge hit with our Zumba ladies! Such a refreshing taste and did use Outback Steakhouse bread as suggested in other reviews as well as making the cream cheese mixture a day ahead of time. The sandwiches were liked by all! Followed the recipe as written but realize there would be calorie savers if used low fat or "light" brands.

These were a great addition to my recent tea party! I followed the recipe exactly as written. 
They kind of treated like a creamy salad sandwich! Next time I'll try making it without the ranch packet, though. I think they'll be much better with just the Dill and flavored cream cheese. 
I used a Japanese sandwich press to seal the edges of the sandwich and get rid of the crusts. It turned them into a fun sandwich pita!
Never got to the sandwich part. Made spread and then cut up cucumber and dipped into spread. (skipped the bread) It was great.
A family favorite! We sprinkle dill weed on top and season cream cheese mixture with some of a dry Italian Dressing packet. We also prefer rye bread. Our grandkids loved these as toddlers, too.

Served this, not open faced but regular 2 piece of bread style sandwich for a group of about 20 people. Everyone loved!!! Even by 12 & 8 year old! I used a combo of light and regular cream cheese as well as a combo of light and regular sour cream to save on calories and it was still good. Also, I didn't have whipped cream cheese with chives so I used some fresh finely chopped green onions. And I forgot the fresh dill...however sandwiches were a hit and there was nothing left over! I served as snack along with the spinach pasta salad recipe from Kim Fusich on this site.

I only used 1 Tablespoon of the Ranch dressing packet. Made it to bring for Easter, and got rave reviews from the guys as well as women.
FYI, whipped cream cheese with chives container is now 7.5 oz.
Easy, easy, easy.

I made this for a church get-together and everybody loved it, even though I forgot the sour cream! I used dill weed spice in the mixture because I didn't have any fresh dill weed. I will definitely make again, and maybe add a little Worcestershire sauce as someone mentioned.

These were very yummy! I didn’t keep them open-faced; just used regular white sandwich bread, and cut each sandwich into four smaller squares. However, I still have about 8oz-10oz of the spread left, so I was thinking to pipe it on some crackers and and top it with smoked salmon. What do you all think?
This dip is so easy to make and everyone loved it.
Very good and easy to make

I followed the recipe in the magazine. In called for 8 Persian cucumbers. Why? I'm not sure. I only used/needed two. The cream cheese mixture was more than enough to make these. These are delicious. Very refreshing on a hot summer day!
So easy and delicious! I think I have a new go to party dish!
Love these! I made the recipe as written but made close-face sandwiches.
I love these little party sandwiches
Tasty appetizer, will make again
best cucumber sandwiches I've had. Had extra cream cheese mixture, so made a few "tortilla roll ups" (also from this site)

I made these for a party. My guests loved them! 

The sandwiches looked elegant with fresh dill sprinkles and the sauce had an unexpected tang. I used party-sized pumpernickel bread and made no changes to the recipe. I'll make this easy, very popular appetizer again and again.
